properties.field_evidence: Official Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42131800 gives an authoritative, explicitly closed two-part MultiPolygon for POLICE STATION AND STABLES, London Borough of Tower Hamlets, reference LB_935, opened HTML entry-date 2026-02-05, start-date 2009-02-24. Historic England NHLE 1393152 independently identifies the same Bow Road Police Station and Stables, Grade II, first listed on 2009-02-24, statutory address 111 Bow Road, Tower Hamlets. The NHLE confirms the police station of 1903 by John Dixon Butler and associated police stables and accommodation of 1937-38 by Gilbert Mackenzie Trench. This is one official listed-building-outline semantic entity with two polygon components, accepted as one record and one producer delta; separate physical structures are not misrepresented as multiple unique records. Official outline has no NHLE foreign key, so name, borough, address and listing date are independent corroboration. Historical type Police station with stables, not evidence of currently operating service or cadastral parcel materialization.
